methodDetails.mode: Read-only current-source audit; writes restricted to ignored .work evidence/helpers.
methodDetails.coverage: All 196 assigned paths were read and SHA-256 checked at entry and exit. All 186 JavaScript/TypeScript files parsed with the pinned rolldown parser. All production component, hook and library executable business logic, lifecycle/owner guards, mutation and recovery paths were inspected using AST-derived semantic source; key high-risk sources were additionally read directly. All 81 production TSX files received a second pass over all 1740 unique child expressions, render branches, map-local computations and displayed status expressions. All seven CSS bodies, entrypoints and configuration files were directly read. This is not a claim that every static JSX text node or every test body was read verbatim.
productionFocus: authentication transitions and MFA volatile state
API operation journal and unknown delivery
approval preview admission and typed forms
media signatures/dimensions/URL lifetime and markdown render budgets
methodDetails.testCoverage: All 68 test/support files structurally parsed; all discovered test and parameterized-case declaration contracts reviewed. 662 AST contract expressions are not a testcase execution count. Full direct test body reads: session.test.ts, builtin-auth.test.tsx, dialog.test.tsx, operation-generation.test.ts, operations.test.ts, drafts.test.tsx; first 180 lines of mcp-media.test.tsx additionally inspected; preview-server.mjs read in full. No tests executed.
methodDetails.documentation: web/VERIFICATION.md implementation connections and declared browser bounds read; historical verification sections were not intentionally used as evidence. Accidental exposure described separately.
methodDetails.independenceLimitation: While searching headings in current web/VERIFICATION.md, a regex that also matched audit/round returned historical audit-repair summaries and past test-result counts. Their linked reports were not opened and these summaries were not used to guide the review, but this breached the requested no-prior-findings exposure boundary. The parent was informed immediately. This report is intentionally not eligible as a blind clean-audit gate.
